evidenceQuote: The voter has only the following legal ways to return the absentee ballot:
rule: Return absentee ballots by U.S. mail, commercial carrier, or personal hand delivery to the absentee election manager. Alabama's stated legal return routes do not include unattended ballot drop boxes.
returnDeadline: Mail must reach the absentee election manager by noon on Election Day. Hand delivery is due by close of business, no later than 5 p.m., the day before the election.
emergencyException: Emergency absentee voting permits delivery by a designee.
